mapper.select: SELECT id, user_no, name, email, start_date, password, role_cd, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
SELECT id, user_no, name, email, start_date, password, role_cd, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT id, user_no, name, email, start_date, role_cd, created_at, updated_at FROM users ORDER BY user_no LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users( user_no, name, email, start_date, password, role_cd, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES( #{userNo}, #{name}, #{email}, #{startDate}, #{password}, #{roleCd}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE users user_no = #{userNo}, name = #{name}, start_date = #{startDate}, role_cd = #{roleCd}, password = #{password}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
